name: csb-screen-rgb-temporal-components
input: hash-verified safe RGB only; no route, projection, actor ID, GT, masks or depth
background: per run/camera temporal median of all RGB frames, computed in 30-row tiles
morphology: none; no merging or projection-guided component selection
score_kind: RGB component area / bbox area; not semantic confidence or calibrated probability
tracking: disabled; no identity association or old dt/distance gates

screening.center_metric: Euclidean xy distance; conservative interpretation of latest user instruction
screening.size_margin_scope: all detections, including non-D27 partial tails; no threshold relaxation
screening.blind_window_interval: half-open; approved conservative envelope design, not measured RGB visibility
screening.switch_boundary: adjacent frames where component count or ambiguity state changes: include both, plus one outer frame per side
screening.d27_target: A only, CAM_W1/CAM_W2 indices 22 through 32 inclusive

limitations: class-agnostic RGB components, not a semantic person detector
shadows, noise, static occupancy, fragments and merges may disagree with people
bbox bottom is not a foot or ground-contact measurement
any-pixel blind visibility cannot be certified with a 64-pixel component floor
model result cannot substitute for D47 human review
